scientific_integrity: Both graph constructions independently identified; entire 2^20-state recurrence for each graph and all 380 ordered opening pairs per graph checked, with a separate recursive replication. Independent external review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite twenty-vertex game classifications only; other generalized Petersen graphs, unindexed literature and external reproducibility not certified.
title: Distance-dual opening responses in the total domination game on the dodecahedron and Desargues graph
